# Scripts

The script each code point belongs to.

<h2 id="script"><code>Script</code></h2>

```rux
pub struct Script {
    // private fields
}
```

A script. `Copy`.
Scripts are named by their long names in the database, such as `Latin` or `Old_Italic`, and found by name loosely:
case, spaces, hyphens and underscores are ignored, so `old italic` names `Old_Italic`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Unicode/Src/Scripts.rux#L10)

**Associated functions**

<h3 id="from-name"><code>FromName</code></h3>

```rux
pub func FromName(name: char8[..]) -> Script?
```

The script whose long name is `name`, matched loosely.

| Name   | Type        | Description                               |
| ------ | ----------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `name` | `char8[..]` | the name, such as `Greek` or `old_italic` |

**Returns**: the script, or `none` when no script has that name

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Unicode/Src/Scripts.rux#L48)

<h3 id="number"><code>Number</code></h3>

```rux

```

The script's number: a stable small integer, less than [`ScriptCount()`](/docs/api/unicode/scripts#script-count), in the order of the scripts' names.

<h3 id="write-name"><code>WriteName</code></h3>

```rux
pub func WriteName(
    self: &Script,
    into: var char8[..]
) -> uint
```

Writes the script's long name, such as `Old_Italic`, into `into`.

| Name   | Type            | Description                                      |
| ------ | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `into` | `var char8[..]` | room for the name; the longest is under 32 bytes |

**Returns**: how many bytes were written, which is fewer than the name's length when `into` is too short
